name: Sheet Pan Cajun-Spiced Drumsticks with Zucchini & Cauliflower
instructions: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and slice zucchini crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Add to the bowl with the chicken along with the cauliflower.
Drizzle chicken and veggies with oil, then sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and salt. Toss to coat.
Divide chicken and veggies between two baking sheet pans, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
